company.name: Trackingplan
company.shortDescription: Trackingplan is an embedded software platform that provides analytics, tracking, and code quality.
company.description: Trackingplan is an automated document monitoring platform that offers automated monitoring that finds problems in your analytics, marketing, attribution pixels, and campaigns. Trackingplan provides traffic anomalies detection of each event with attribution analysis and detect product problems, debug them, and fix the causes.

productsAndServices.description: A platform that automatically monitors and audits digital analytics, marketing pixels, campaigns, and data layers to detect errors and ensure data quality in real time.
productsAndServices.name: Trackingplan Analytics Quality Assurance Platform

productsAndServices.description: Tools within Trackingplan that help identify the origin and cause of data quality issues by analyzing event data and correlations to speed up problem resolution.
productsAndServices.name: Root Cause Analysis and Debugging Tools

productsAndServices.description: A system that validates event sequences, property types, and campaign tagging against predefined specifications to ensure data conforms to expected formats and rules.
productsAndServices.name: Automated Data Validation and Specification Monitoring

productsAndServices.description: Continuous monitoring of all data sent from websites and apps to third-party integrations, providing a comprehensive view of the Martech stack and data flows.
productsAndServices.name: Data and Marketing Observability

productsAndServices.description: A broad set of integrations with analytics, marketing, tag management, and CRM platforms, plus APIs for exporting and managing tracking data.
productsAndServices.name: Integration Ecosystem and API Access
